edges.reason: fallback/receive entrypoint immediately executes _fallback().
_fallback calls the _willFallback hook before delegation.
_fallback calls _delegate with the resolved implementation.
_fallback calls isContract(msg.sender) together with msg.data.length and gasleft checks.
msg.sender is passed into the fallback contract-check branch.
_delegate performs a delegatecall to an implementation address, an external call that can execute arbitrary code and re-enter the proxy.
_implementation sloads the IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT state variable.
the sloaded value is assigned to the local impl variable.
_upgradeTo calls _setImplementation with the new implementation.

admin() returns _admin().
implementation() returns _implementation().
changeAdmin calls _setAdmin(newAdmin).
